scope: DATA-007 lifecycle contract and 27-case evidence map
lifecycle runtime evidence and golden authentication freshness evidence

findings.finding: The exported persistence client exposes retention_purge_Todo(cutoff, onSelected). The primitive checks that an operation instant exists but trusts the supplied cutoff, so an importing host can purge a young row by supplying a recent cutoff instead of the validated configured retention cutoff.
findings.requiredCorrection: Keep the low-level purge primitive private to the generated maintenance worker, or bind it to validated configuration so callers cannot choose a shorter retention. Add executable evidence that a direct exported persistence call cannot purge a young row.

findings.finding: The exported persistence client's create_User/create_Todo methods accept raw records and insert them directly. Compiler-owned lifecycle initial values are added only at source-level create lowering, so a host-side caller can create a disabled User or an already-deleted Todo.
findings.requiredCorrection: Make raw lifecycle creation internal to checked generated calls, or enforce the compiler-owned initial values at the persistence boundary. Add direct-call tests proving a caller cannot create lifecycle-managed rows in a non-initial state.

reviewedWithoutFinding: The lifecycle compiler/runtime slice has concrete SQLite and PostgreSQL coverage for guarded transitions, visibility-before-limit, joins, write races, purge bounds and audit accounting.
The frozen case map correctly keeps actual golden disable/delete HTTP integration within RM-106.
